tool.name: nf-core untar
tool.description: Extract files from tar, tar.gz, tar.bz2, tar.xz archives
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ mkdir ${prefix}
## Ensures --strip-components only applied when top level of tar contents is a directory ## If just files or multiple directories, place all in prefix if [[ \$(tar -taf ${archive} | grep -o -P "^.*?\\/" | uniq | wc -l) -eq 1 ]]; then tar \\ -C ${prefix} --strip-components 1 \\ -xavf \\ ${args} \\ ${archive} \\ ${args2} else tar \\ -C ${prefix} \\ -xavf \\ ${args} \\ ${archive} \\ ${args2} fi
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": untar: \$(echo \$(tar --version 2>&1) | sed 's/^.*(GNU tar) //; s/ Copyright.*\$//') END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Extract files from tar, tar.gz, tar.bz2, tar.xz archives
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: untar Container: ${workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/untar ]]>
